title: The Natyasastra: A Treatise on Hindu Dramaturgy and Histrionics, Vol. I & II

verification.verification_notes: Silo restatement of the shared coordinator-verified record src-natyashastra-ghosh-1951 (tier 1). Chapter 6 (Rasa) enumerates karuna (grief/compassion) and bhayanaka (terror) among the rasas; the present researcher did not re-inspect the translation.

limitations: Classical Sanskrit aesthetic terms are rendered into English; karuna and bhayanaka do not map one-to-one onto 'grief' and 'horror' in modern genre vocabulary.
